name: Refocusing Defense (Combat)
body:
You can center yourself in combat to focus your tactics.

Prerequisite(s): base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): You can use total defense to readjust your initiative. When you enter total defense you gain all the normal benefits, but if you do not move on your turn, you treat your initiative as though you rolled a natural 20 for the rest of combat.
